subject.title: fix(azure): responses model aliases route correctly

question: Should trusted manifest alias metadata be the canonical policy for jointly selecting provider credential ownership and transport across Azure Responses, OpenAI-only Codex models, and GitHub Copilot models?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but this precedence rule decides which provider's credentials and protocol are used across multiple owner boundaries; repository policy requires explicit owner confirmation for that authentication-sensitive contract.

options.title: Confirm policy and refresh
options.body: Approve the atomic trusted-alias owner/transport policy, refresh the branch onto current main, and rerun exact-head review and CI.

options.title: Keep ownership plugin-local
options.body: Reject the generic resolver policy and require Azure-specific ownership handling through the provider plugin seam, accepting a narrower but potentially duplicated implementation.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave the linked bug open with the classic Azure provider as the workaround until maintainers define a different cross-provider alias contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm policy and refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the atomic trusted-alias owner/transport policy, refresh the branch onto current main, and rerun exact-head review and CI.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider/model runtime work makes @vincentkoc the strongest available owner for confirming the cross-provider ownership contract.
